items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: I know one thing. When, uh, uh, uh, what's his name, um, Good Rockin' the Night, uh. Roy Brown. Roy Brown had that record.

ctx.x: All right. Uh, and so when, when you got out, what, what did, uh, what did you just, did you know what you were gonna do? Now you're gonna be. No, I mean, I'm still young. I'm still young.
